GameController

class GameController(surface, settings, state, config_service, phase_service, recorder, camera, pose_tracking)[source]

Bases: object

KarTEA game controller: match rules and frame flow.

Everything arrives by injection (created once in main): GameSettings (configuration), GameState (match state), the configuration service (player interface options), the phase service (progression and level rules), the SessionRecorder (persistence), the camera and the pose tracking.

Delegated responsibilities:

  • LaneDetector: feet position -> lane;

  • HudView: drawing of the HUD;

  • FeedbackView: hit/miss sound and image;

  • SessionRecorder: session, events and configuration;

  • models (Target, Obstacle, Car): return KillResult.

Attributes:
FINISH_LINE_LEAD_TIMEfloat, class attribute

Minimum time (s) before the end at which the finish line appears (12).

FINISH_COUNTDOWN_DURATIONfloat, class attribute

Duration (s) of the timer animation to zero after the finish line is crossed (2).

LANE_CHANGE_POINTSint, class attribute

Points per lane change (2).

LEVEL_COUNTER_BY_EVENTdict[EventType, str], class attribute

Removal event -> level counter (LevelStats) it increments.

MENU_CHOICE_EVENTSdict[str, EventType], class attribute

Menu choice made with mouse/keyboard (pause or end of level) -> “Controle UFE” detail event.

FEET_MENU_CHOICE_EVENTSdict[str, EventType], class attribute

The same choices made by the player with the feet -> “Controle do Jogador” event. “game” depends on the screen: “Jogar” in the start menu, “Continuar” in the pause menu.

INTERFACE_OPTION_EVENTSdict, class attribute

Interface option -> (event when enabled, event when disabled).

change_level(action)[source]

Apply a level change to the GameState.

Used by the end-of-level result (the game’s recommendation) and by the professional’s choices in the pause menu. The progression rule belongs to the service, from the phase CSV files.

Parameters:
actionstr

“next”, “prev” or “rest” (see KarteaPhaseService.change_level).

reset()[source]

Start a new level (after advance, regress or restart).

Notes

The session totals are not reset: the score and lane changes of the ending level are added to the session accumulated values. Session and configuration are saved right away, since phase/level just changed.

register_menu_choice(choice, by_feet=False)[source]

Record a decision made in a menu.

Must be called BEFORE the choice is applied, so that the event phase and level are those of the level where the decision was made.

Parameters:
choicestr

“next”, “rest”, “prev”, “exit”, “play” or “game”.

by_feetbool, optional

True when the player chose with the feet (feet click).

Notes

With mouse or keyboard (by_feet False) the decision is the professional’s (“Controle UFE”); “Jogar” and “Continuar” are not recorded (the Unpause is recorded when the game resumes). With the feet (by_feet True) the decision is the player’s own (“Controle do Jogador”), including “Jogar” and “Continuar”.

Without an open session, exiting records nothing, so that no empty session is created; “Jogar” with the feet opens the session, which would start at the first game event anyway. The session totals are saved before the choice is applied.

save_session()[source]

Save the session and the configuration (current values).

spawn_targets()[source]

Create a target or obstacle according to the level rules.

Notes

Interval, maximum amount and type of each object come from the phase CSV (LevelRules). Nothing is created while the spawn timer has not expired or the level limit was reached. The object is attached to the road line ahead of the camera and a “Criou” event is recorded.

spawn_finish()[source]

Place the finish line on the road.

Notes

The road is a loop: the same line may have been passed on an earlier lap, so its passed mark is reset to detect only the crossing of this finish line.

set_feet_position()[source]

Position the car from the detected feet position.

draw()[source]

Draw the road, the car and the HUD.

Notes

The road stops while a pause is requested. The feet dot is drawn when the player’s feet_marker option is on.

game_time_update()[source]

Update the time left in the level from the game clock.

update(events=None)[source]

Run one frame of the game (main update loop).

Parameters:
eventslist, optional

Pygame events already read by the main loop (main.py). The event queue must be read only once per frame; if None, the queue is read here (compatibility).

Returns:
str | None

“menu” when the game must go to a menu (pause or end of level); None to stay in the game.

Notes

Order of a frame: clock and autosave, camera and feet, automatic pause, timer, spawning, finish line and countdown, drawing, active play (until the finish line), feedback image, end of level and keyboard events. Without a camera frame, the frame ends early.
